provenance.description: Item alignment (blind item <-> corpus entry_id <-> title) and the per-stratum label crosswalk, transcribed verbatim from comparison.md's own Item/Title/Blind verdict/Pipeline relation table (18/18 agreement oracle) for task-packets/N1-T01.yaml R3. No item, title, or mapping here is invented: every row mirrors a row comparison.md itself states. comparison.md documents it was produced AFTER the freeze commits dab655c (blind-brief.md) and f4136f1 (blind-returns.json) — the blind pass demonstrably had no access to the pipeline classification at return time.
provenance.raw_label_note: Raw labels (pipeline: corpus-entries.json[].evidence_relation; blind: blind-returns.json[].verdict) are NOT duplicated in this file — they are read live from those two committed files at validation time, so this crosswalk can never drift from them by silently going stale. This file supplies only the ALIGNMENT (which blind item corresponds to which corpus entry) and the LABEL MAP (raw label -> common-space label), per stratum.

raters.blind: K1-T06 blind, independent verifying-instance classification (blind-returns.json[].verdict) — an independent INSTANCE, not a human gold standard; see reliability_not_validity in the rendered report.

reference_rater_note: Named per R1/R2: without human gold, per-category precision/recall/F1 and the majority-class baseline are asymmetric, not a validity measurement. 'pipeline' (the K1-T04 run's own classification) is named the reference rater by convention for this report; 'blind' (the K1-T06 verifying instance) is equally not a gold standard — swapping the two changes which side's marginal grounds precision/recall, never which one is 'correct'.

source_files._resolution_note: Both paths are relative to this crosswalk file's own directory (corpora/model-collapse/verification/), not to any caller's current working directory — resolved as (this_file.parent / relative_path).
